key_highlights: ASX 200 creeps higher after absorbing offshore volatility from Wall Street sell-off
ANZ reports robust FY profit of $7.6b while warning of rising residential mortgage delinquencies
AUD plunges under macro headwinds, compounding RBA policy dilemma between sticky inflation and property contraction
Resources sector displays mixed performance: junior gold and critical minerals surge while iron ore and oil struggle

sectors.trend: Bulk commodities remain subdued on Chinese demand concerns, but gold and critical minerals exploration show strong resource upgrades
sectors.implications: Rotate away from pure-play iron ore miners (FMG.AX, RIO.AX) toward gold producers and strategic critical mineral developers

sectors.trend: Major banks maintain elevated cash earnings, but credit quality begins to deteriorate amid Australia's steepest housing downturn
sectors.implications: Net interest margin peaks face headwind from rising loan-loss provisions; cap upside on major lenders (ANZ.AX, CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX)

sectors.trend: Crude oil faces prolonged recovery path while domestic and regional natural gas assets secure long-term exploration and extraction permits
sectors.implications: Favour defensive LNG and gas infrastructure operators (WDS.AX, STO.AX) over pure crude oil exposures

sectors.trend: AI-led data centre demand hits real-world power grid bottlenecks and local moratorium calls
sectors.implications: Execution risks and connection delays could temper short-term multiples for data centre operators and developer REITs

sectors.trend: Retailers brace for Black Friday discounting while department store anchor instability creates headwinds for shopping mall landlords
sectors.implications: Exercise caution on retail REITs (SCG.AX, VCX.AX); consumer spending contraction limits discretionary retail multiples

key_themes: Mortgage stress and housing downturn accelerating as RBA tight financial conditions take toll
AUD weakness generating imported cost inflation despite domestic economic softness
Energy transition and AI infrastructure facing power transmission and regulatory bottlenecks

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Accelerating Housing Price Downturn & Mortgage Arrears
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight high-LVR mortgage exposed lenders; increase exposure to defensive consumer staples and diversified healthcare
Hold USD-earning offshore ASX corporates (CSL.AX, COH.AX) and unhedged global assets

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Bulk Commodity Price Slump (Iron Ore & Thermal Coal)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Trim weightings in bulk miners (FMG.AX, BHP.AX) in favour of precious metals and energy transition minerals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Data Centre Grid Constraints & Moratorium Risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Focus on data centre operators with secured power purchase agreements and dual-fuel backup facilities

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate gold producers on resource expansions and safe-haven demand
opportunities.rationale: High-grade regional discoveries and currency weakness boost AUD-denominated bullion margins

opportunities.recommendation: Position in strategic domestic natural gas and critical mineral exploration assets
opportunities.rationale: Long-term gas licensing in Beetaloo and critical minerals (scandium/gallium) align with sovereign resource priorities

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge ASX 200 exposure against banking and property drag
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising 90-day mortgage arrears and major housing correction risk repricing index banking weights

defensive_moves.recommendation: Rotate into defensive staples and offshore revenue generators
defensive_moves.rationale: Insulates portfolio from domestic consumption headwinds and benefits from AUD weakness

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX 200 trading as banking earnings resilience battles mounting residential mortgage stress and weak AUD
market_outlook.long_term: Subdued recovery contingent on RBA easing cycle, housing stabilisation, and structural demand for Australian energy and critical minerals

Q3 Australian GDP and wage price index prints
China property stimulus and iron ore demand indicators
Black Friday retail sales volumes and consumer credit data

Dalian Commodity Exchange iron ore futures
